en.title: Disney+ Drops Spooky Classics and Football Faves for September 2026
en.summary: Get ready for a frightfully good time and gridiron action as Disney+ unveils its September 2026 lineup. Beloved spooky favorites and exciting football content are set to headline the streaming service.
en.body:
As the leaves begin to turn and the air grows crisp, Disney+ is ushering in the fall season with a curated selection of titles designed to delight both horror aficionados and sports fans. September 2026 on the platform promises a blend of chilling classics and gridiron excitement, signaling a strategic push for seasonal engagement.

The streamer is set to welcome a trio of cult-favorite spooky films that have cemented their place in the horror canon. **Coraline**, the stop-motion animated dark fantasy from Laika, known for its eerie atmosphere and inventive storytelling, will be available. Alongside it, **ParaNorman**, another Laika gem celebrated for its blend of humor and heartfelt themes tackling prejudice, joins the lineup. Rounding out the horror-tinged offerings is **Jennifer's Body**, Diablo Cody's sharp and witty take on the demonic possession subgenre, which has seen a significant resurgence in popularity and critical re-evaluation in recent years.

Beyond the spectral scares, Disney+ is also doubling down on football content. The platform is gearing up for the season premieres of several familiar favorites. While the teaser doesn't specify which shows, it strongly implies that series centered around American football, a consistently popular genre, will be a major draw. This move taps into the massive audience that follows the sport, especially during its peak season, offering a mix of drama, comedy, and potentially sports documentary-style content that resonates deeply with dedicated fans.

## Fans Ready for Spooky Season and Gridiron Action

This programming strategy clearly aims to capture the attention of a broad spectrum of Disney+ subscribers. For those eagerly anticipating the Halloween season, the inclusion of **Coraline**, **ParaNorman**, and **Jennifer's Body** offers a potent dose of nostalgic chills and contemporary cult appeal. These films, while varied in tone, all share a dedicated fanbase that appreciates their unique artistic visions and memorable characters. Simultaneously, the emphasis on football content directly addresses the passionate community of sports enthusiasts, providing them with familiar series to dive into as the professional and college seasons kick off. The combination suggests a deliberate effort to cater to diverse tastes within the platform's global audience, aiming for sustained viewership throughout the month.

## What's Next for September

While specific premiere dates for the football series and the exact day these films become available have not yet been announced, the arrival of these titles marks a significant shift in Disney+'s content calendar. Fans can anticipate further announcements regarding the full September slate, which will likely include more details on the football shows and potentially other family-friendly or genre content to complement the spooky and sporting themes. The platform is clearly setting the stage for a robust fall viewing experience.
